text: Sukhā, bhikkhave, dhammadesanā; sukho saṅghassa samaggī.
gloss: Happy is the teaching of the Dhamma; happy the harmony of the Sangha.

text: Sabbe saṅkhārā dukkhā'ti yadā paññāya passati, atha nibbindati dukkhe.
gloss: When one sees with wisdom that all formations are suffering, one turns away from suffering.

text: Tassa kālaṁ vadanti: uposatho catuddasiko pañcadasiko ca.
gloss: They state the time: the uposatha is on the fourteenth and fifteenth.

text: Vimatiṁ vippahāyitvā sāvako pāmojjabahulo jāto; cittaṁ odātaṁ pasannaṁ.
gloss: Abandoning doubt the disciple became full of joy; the mind bright and confident.

text: Bāhirako coro sabbaṁ gehaṁ haritvā palāyi; tassa gehasāmī dukkhito ahosi, socati kilamati.
gloss: An outside thief carried off the whole house and fled; the householder was sorrowful, mourned and toiled.

text: Imasmiṁ gāme tisso vihārāyo saṃvijjanti; eko pacchimako, dve purimakā.
gloss: In this village there are three monasteries; one later, two earlier.

text: Ānandassa thero vaṇṇaṁ bhāsittha: sādhu sādhu'ti vatvā cittaṁ muduṁ sukhitaṁ ahosi.
gloss: The elder spoke praise of Ānanda; saying 'good, good', his mind was tender and happy.

text: Pubbaṇhasamayaṁ vāto uṭṭhāya nāvaṁ bhindāpesi; na koci jīvitaṁ laddhuṁ asakkhi, sabbe vinassaṁsu.
gloss: At dawn a wind rose and wrecked the boat; no one could survive, all perished.

text: Purimapurisaṁ disvāva saha pañhasatiyeha sammodamāno kālaṁ aviññātaṁ atināmesi.
gloss: On seeing an old companion he rejoiced together and passed the time unaware.

text: Rattiṁ paṭhamaṁ yāmaṁ sati kāye kāyānupassanāya pavattati.
gloss: In the first watch of the night mindfulness proceeds as contemplation of the body in the body.

text: Sāsanaṁ bhajamānā yakkhā sappaṁ dasitvā pāpikaṁ vedanaṁ janayiṁsu.
gloss: Tormenting spirits had a serpent bite him and produced painful feeling.

text: Dīgharattaṁ virataṁ pañcasīlaṁ samādiyitvā upāsako suvimutto 'sammā vata' ti attamano ahosi.
gloss: Having long undertaken the five precepts the lay follower was well released, pleased, thinking 'well done indeed'.

text: Atthakathā vuccati: atthato nayo; byañjanato nayo; ubhayato nayo.
gloss: The commentary says: method by meaning; method by phrasing; method by both.

text: Mātā sokena avatiṇṇā rodati paridevati; puttassa maraṇaṁ na khamati.
gloss: The mother sunk in grief weeps and laments; the son's death is unbearable.

text: Antevāsikā paṭhamavāre pātimokkhaṁ sammā uddisitvā therānaṁ pasādaṁ ajjhagamā.
gloss: The pupil recited the Pātimokkha rightly for the first time and won the elders' favour.

text: Gāmakoḷumbhatitthe vassaṁ caturo māse saṁvattanti; tattha bhikkhū vassaṁ vasiṁsu.
gloss: At the village landing the rains run four months; the monks dwelt there for the rains.

text: Thero sātireko phāsuniko nivāso laddho; abhiññā sacchikatā, cittaṁ vimuttaṁ.
gloss: The elder gained a pleasant abode; direct knowledge realized, the mind liberated.

text: Vatthaṁ nāthānaṁ natthaṁ; gharaṁ vikkiṇṇaṁ; dve māsā nivāso aṭṭhito.
gloss: Property of the lordless lost; the house sold; two months of dwelling remained.

text: Saradarattiyo vippasannā honti; jhānaṁ anupavattati, na kiñci uppajjati.
source: composed; label corrected 2026-09-26: absorption/jhāna carries adukkham-asukhā vedanā in the canon (upekkhā-sati-pārisuddhi), not sukha
gloss: Autumn nights are serene; absorption proceeds, nothing arises.

text: Saṅgahitattā suttantānaṁ catasso nikāyā ādito, ekā khuddaka pacchā.
gloss: Of the collected discourses there are four Nikāyas first, one minor last.

text: Dāruṇaṁ vācati: 'na tvaṁ mayhaṁ samma sāsanaṁ rakkhati'; codito bhikkhu kampati.
gloss: He speaks harshly: 'you do not guard the Dispensation rightly'; the rebuked monk trembles.

text: Nīvaraṇaṁ pahātaṁ; ekasmim pade doso diṭṭho, sātakaṁ vissodhitaṁ.
gloss: The hindrance abandoned; in one line the fault was seen, the whole purified.

text: Tassa bhattaṁ: odano kummāso sūpo maṁsaṁ ca pañcavidhena.
gloss: His meal: rice, gruel, curry and meat of five kinds.

text: Yaṁ sattarattindivaṁ likhitaṁ taṁ sabbaṁ punavārite; ācariyassa Āṇā upari vipallāsi.
gloss: All that was written over seven days must be redone; the teacher's instruction changed upstream.

text: Dārakā uyyāne bījāni ropenti; hasamānā paṁsuṁ kīḷanti.
gloss: The children plant seeds in the garden; laughing they play in the soil.

text: Paccūsasamaye lekhanī saṃrakkhitā; catucattālīsaṁ gaṇanā, doso n'atthi.
gloss: At dawn the script was kept safe; forty-four counted, no fault.

text: Saṅgho vikupito; sabbe sahāyakā vippakiṇṇā, pañcadine yeva nissaritabbā.
gloss: The assembly is shattered; all companions scattered, to depart within five days.

text: Anuggaho laddho: dve vassāni dānakkhandho nirodhaṁ vinā.
gloss: The grant was won: two years of provision without cessation.

text: Potthakaṁ kālatikkante divasaṁ paṭi catupaṇṇāso naṇo deyyo.
gloss: For a book overdue, four-and-fifty small coins per day are to be given.
